verdict.line: You lose if you let Kled stack Violent Tendencies autos on you for free; you win if you punish him the moment Skaarl dies and he's forced into Pocket Pistol.

brief.thesis: This is a dismount-timing matchup: Kled's damage and all-in threat collapse the instant Skaarl's health bar empties, so your entire job is tracking that bar and detonating Q (The Darkin Blade) and Deathbringer Stance only after he's grounded. The 50.4% win rate over 139 games with Kled holding lane and solo-kill advantage says he wins the mounted trades — you win the dismounted ones.

theirWindow.what: He's hunting 4 empowered attacks from W (Violent Tendencies) with the 4th hitting hardest, backed by Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) yanking you in. Don't stand still in his 800-range hook threat during this window — circle minions so the Q skillshot has to travel and can be avoided per OP.GG's own read on this matchup.

yourWindow.what: He deals less damage to champions while dismounted and his Q becomes the short-range Pocket Pistol knockback. This is when you dash in with E (Umbral Dash), land Q (The Darkin Blade) swings back to back, and pop Deathbringer Stance — his courage regen punishes slow trades, so burst it before he remounts.

start.why: 49% win rate over 98 games and the 58.7% pick rate — the raw AD and sustain help you survive his Q yank-ins while you wait for a dismount window.

boots.why: 52.5% win rate over 139 games at 85.8% pick — the auto-attack damage reduction directly counters his Violent Tendencies 4-hit burst.

core.why: The shield and burst proc punish him the exact moment he dismounts, matching the highest-sampled build path (60% win rate over 10 games).
Cooldown reduction lets your Q (The Darkin Blade) and E (Umbral Dash) cycle faster than his 13/12/11/10/9s W and E cooldowns.
Appears in every top build path here — the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his dismounted all-in while you out-sustain with Deathbringer Stance heals.

runes.keystoneWhy: 51.4% win rate at 42.1% pick — the stacking adaptive force rewards drawn-out trades, which is exactly what you want once Skaarl dies and the fight turns into a straight DPS race.

playing.title: Track Skaarl's bar, not Kled's
playing.detail: His champion health is irrelevant while mounted — Skaarl absorbs it. Only commit to all-ins when Skaarl's bar is near empty.

playing.title: Dodge his Q skillshot on cooldown
playing.detail: Bear Trap on a Rope is 800 range on an 11/10/9/8/7s cooldown — sidestep it near minions so he wastes the cast instead of yanking you into his W burst.

playing.title: Punish the dismount instantly
playing.detail: The moment Skaarl dies, his kit downgrades and Pocket Pistol only knocks him back — dash in with E (Umbral Dash) and unload Q swings before he can fight for courage to remount.

playing.title: Save Deathbringer Stance for the dismount
playing.detail: Your passive's bonus magic damage and heal scale off max health — landing it on dismounted Kled during his weak window maximizes the heal when you need it most.

playing.title: Play around his W windup
playing.detail: Violent Tendencies gives him 4 empowered attacks with the 4th hardest-hitting — back off or trade through armor (Plated Steelcaps) rather than standing still in it.

playing.title: Use R (World Ender) to close, not open
playing.detail: With a 120/100/80/80/80s cooldown, save World Ender for when Skaarl is already down — the attack speed and healing let you finish the dismounted fight outright.

playing.title: Don't force fights before level 9
playing.detail: His solo-kill advantage is real in the early trades — wait for Eclipse's power spike around level 9-11 before initiating off cooldowns.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — why these choices work, the dismount timing, the trade windows — is my own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Kled’s (Q) when facing him. Deal burst damage repeatedly by using your skills whenever they come off cooldown to gain lane control once he dismounts Skaal.
